hero.eyebrow: Micro-label above main heading indicating industry compliance or technical specialization (e.g., 'HIPAA-compliant, clinically grounded'). Max 5 words.

h1.h1: Main topic title combining service and industry (e.g., 'RAG chatbot development for healthcare:').
h1.span: Value proposition or deliverable highlight suffix (e.g., 'HIPAA-compliant clinical & patient AI'). Max 6 words.

hero.hero-sub: Introductory paragraph explaining how the specialized technical service solves core industry data, regulatory, or workflow challenges with zero compromise on accuracy. Exactly 2-3 sentences.

cred.b: Cred highlight text (e.g., '5+ yrs healthcare AI', '100% HIPAA & BAA ready', '48h architecture spec'). Max 5 words.

btn-primary.text: Action-oriented primary CTA button text (e.g., 'Discuss your healthcare project'). Max 5 words.

btn-ghost.text: Secondary ghost CTA button text (e.g., 'View case studies'). Max 4 words.

hero.live: Trust statement guaranteeing data isolation, compliance standards, and signed agreements before data access. Exactly 1 sentence.

trust.span: Metric explanation (e.g., 'Years building healthcare AI', 'HIPAA & PHI audit compliance', 'To a written technical spec'). Max 5 words.
